generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

codes.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the information sent was invalid.
codes.OUTSIDE_COVERAGE: This location is outside the pilot area.
codes.OFF_NETWORK: This point is too far from the mapped walking network.
codes.BBOX_TOO_LARGE: The map area is too large. Zoom in.
codes.NO_ROUTE: No route was found with these settings.
codes.UNAUTHORIZED: You're not authorised to do this.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
codes.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: An external data provider (such as Environment Canada weather) is unavailable right now. Nothing is shown in its place: no old or invented values.
codes.WRITES_DISABLED: Sending is turned off in this public demo.
codes.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to answer.
codes.WAKE_TIMEOUT: The server didn't wake up in time. It's on a free plan that sleeps when idle; try again in a moment.
codes.INCOMPLETE: The server's answer was incomplete, so nothing is shown rather than a partial result.
